stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS / College Navigator (fall 2024): 3,529 applicants, 82% admitted (rounded; the admit count is not shown), 23% of admitted enrolled. No Common Data Set was found on vermontstate.edu (searched twice), so SAT/ACT percentiles, GPA, intl applicants/admits and C7 factors are not filled in. IPEDS lists SAT/ACT as not considered, while the admissions site says scores are optional and considered if submitted. Vermont State is a multi-campus university (Castleton, Johnson, Lyndon, Randolph, Williston and learning sites); IPEDS reports it as one institution. The Randolph address is the IPEDS main address. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.
